changelog: Programme artwork now arrives in Jellyfin's own Live TV guide. The server records a programme's image from its path alone, leaving the modification date and the pixel dimensions blank, and each omission breaks the picture in its own way: with no dimensions every request is answered with the full-size original instead of a thumbnail, and the blank date reaches the browser as a date of year one, on the strength of which the server answers "not modified" with an empty body - so the card stays empty waiting for a cached copy it was never given. Both fields are now filled in from the artwork itself, after every guide refresh and once at startup.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
